headline: The co-chair of Soles4Souls Twin Cities says her life is filled to overflowing, and that new shoes tell a kid someone cares.
story: Virginia co-chairs Soles4Souls Twin Cities. This was their second shoe distribution at Mall of America: 500 of the 10,000 homeless kids in the Twin Cities got new shoes.
Asked if she is happy, she says she is beyond happy. She feels called to serve, and giving her gifts makes her one happy camper.
Cool new shoes signal that someone cares. Confidence changes, kids go to school and play sports. Just a pair of shoes, but it can change the world.
